understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by positioning all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked with `+` on the semantic grid, ensuring every `+` was simultaneously occupied to trigger a WIN and progress through all levels until the game was fully won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) attempted to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels per cell) in the chosen direction; movement could be blocked by walls or other objects, though the movement_blocked hints were only heuristic and didn’t guarantee failure. Some objects (blocks) could be pushable if adjacent in the move direction, moving along with the selected piece when pushed. When multiple selectable pieces were present, control could be switched using CLICK on the exact pixel-coordinate position of another selectable, changing `player.id`/`player.position` to that piece.
